title: Keynote: The Future of AI-Native Java
speaker: James Gosling
description: A deep dive into how Java is evolving to become the premier platform for AI-native applications, from Project Valhalla to vector APIs.

title: Building Production-Grade AI Agents with LangChain4j
speaker: Dmytro Liubarskyi
description: Learn how to build reliable AI agents using LangChain4j with tool calling, RAG, and memory. Covers patterns for production deployments.

title: Kubernetes Operators in Java: Beyond the Basics
speaker: Bilgin Ibryam
description: Advanced patterns for building Kubernetes operators in Java using the Java Operator SDK. Covers reconciliation, dependent resources, and testing.

title: Quarkus 4.0: What's New and What's Next
speaker: Emmanuel Bernard
description: Tour of Quarkus 4.0 features including improved Dev Services, enhanced AI integration, and the new reactive pipeline model.

title: A2A Protocol: Building Agent-to-Agent Communication
speaker: Salaboy
description: Introduction to the A2A protocol for inter-agent communication. Learn how to build agents that discover and collaborate with each other.

title: Microservices Observability with OpenTelemetry
speaker: Ted Young
description: End-to-end observability for microservices using OpenTelemetry. Covers traces, metrics, logs, and how to correlate them for debugging.

title: Spring Boot 4: AI-First Application Development
speaker: Josh Long
description: How Spring Boot 4 embraces AI-first development with Spring AI, native A2A support, and intelligent auto-configuration.

title: GraalVM Native Image: Instant Startup for AI Workloads
speaker: Alina Yurenko
description: Using GraalVM native image to achieve sub-second startup times for AI agent services. Covers reflection configuration and memory optimization.

title: Securing Multi-Agent Systems with OAuth2 and mTLS
speaker: Rob Winch
description: Security patterns for agent meshes: OAuth2 token exchange between agents, mTLS for service identity, and fine-grained authorization.

title: RAG at Scale: Vector Databases and Java
speaker: Cédric Champeau
description: Building scalable RAG pipelines in Java using LangChain4j with pgvector, Milvus, and Qdrant. Covers chunking strategies and re-ranking.

title: Workshop: Hands-On A2A Agent Lab
speaker: DevConf Team
description: Build a complete multi-agent system using A2A protocol, LangChain4j, and multiple runtimes. Bring your laptop!

title: From Monolith to Agent Mesh: A Migration Story
speaker: Holly Cummins
description: Real-world case study of migrating a monolithic customer service system to an agent-based architecture using A2A and MCP.
